Record Class HoodHoming.Inputs

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
frc.robot.subsystems.hood.HoodHoming.Inputs
Record Components:
nowSeconds - the robot clock
enabled - the robot is enabled
autonomous - the Driver Station is in autonomous
teleop - the Driver Station is in teleop
motorConnected - the hood motor's signals are arriving
motorReset - the hood motor rebooted this loop, restarting its position
positionDeg - measured hood angle; NaN while a zero has not reached the readings, which starts no re-home on stow
degPerSec - measured hood speed
wantsHome - the hood is being sent to its stop
trackingStopped - the hood's tracking stop holds it in neutral
Enclosing class:
HoodHoming
public static record HoodHoming.Inputs(double nowSeconds, boolean enabled, boolean autonomous, boolean teleop, boolean motorConnected, boolean motorReset, double positionDeg, double degPerSec, boolean wantsHome, boolean trackingStopped) extends Record
One loop's view of the hood, every field from a logged input.
